test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pk_wholly_matching_ranges (c1 DateTime, c2 UInt8, c3 LowCardinality(String), c4 UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(c1) PRIMARY KEY (c1, c2, c3) ORDER BY (c1, c2, c3, c4) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pk_wholly_matching_ranges SELECT toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00') + (number % 16) * 86400 + intDiv(number, 64), intDiv(number, 16) % 2, concat('e', toString(number % 5)), number FROM numbers_mt(1200000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM pk_wholly_matching_ranges WHERE c2 LIMIT 1 SETTINGS max_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
